name: Ravia Ligoni
source:
The Agile Wolf

Captain of the girl's track team. Possesses an insane work ethic, and is often found training solo well beyond the end of practice. Sets a high standard for herself and looks down on slackers. Sees little reason for feminine activities and pleasantries. Rather cold and distant even with those she is acquainted with.

Hobbies: Improving her track times, postponing leaving the school?
